title: Half the Sky — Character Card
description: A historical woman on the wall of Half the Sky (半边天). Each card contains Wikipedia-verified biographical facts, voice description, example dialogues, and character boundaries for AI persona use. Provenance fields (`sources`, `fact_check`) are bilingual: English is canonical, `*_zh` carries the Chinese. / 溯源字段为中英双语，英文为准，`*_zh` 为中文。

id.description: URL-safe slug used as the character identifier, e.g. 'wu-zetian'

name.description: Display name, optionally with native script, e.g. 'Wu Zetian 武则天'

place.description: Primary geography, e.g. 'Tang China' or 'Warsaw · Paris'

facts.description: Biographical facts, each checkable against an entry in `sources`. Specific dates, numbers, names and direct quotes. Team achievements are attributed to the team. Contested claims keep their hedges. The AI persona speaks ONLY from these facts.

voice.description: Short description of how this person speaks — tone, cadence, habits of mind. Used to guide AI persona voice.

examples.description: Example visitor-reply dialogue pairs demonstrating the character's tone. Not repeated verbatim; used as style reference.

visitor.description: What a visitor might say or ask

reply.description: How this character would respond, grounded in her biographical facts

boundaries.description: Things the AI persona must never do or say while in character. Prevents anachronisms, fabricated quotes, out-of-character behavior.

sources.description: Where the facts in this card were checked. Prefer primary documents and official archives, then universities, museums, courts, prize bodies and learned societies, then peer-reviewed work, then reference works and reporting.

label.description: Short human-readable name of the source

url.description: Direct link. All links are HTTP-checked before being added.

kind.description: Weight of the source, strongest first.

note.description: Caveats, e.g. the host blocks automated requests

kind_zh.description: Chinese label for `kind` / 来源类型的中文标签

note_zh.description: Chinese version of `note` / note 的中文版

fact_check.description: Provenance of the most recent review of this card.

rounds.description: How many independent review passes the card has had

corrections.description: What was factually wrong before this review

additions.description: What had been omitted before this review

summary_zh.description: Chinese version of `summary` / summary 的中文版

corrections_zh.description: Chinese version of `corrections` / corrections 的中文版

additions_zh.description: Chinese version of `additions` / additions 的中文版
